title: [CON-16] The KeyPackage Store API is referenced as a versioned surface but its wire protocol is nev
description: Review finding CON-16: The KeyPackage Store API is referenced as a versioned surface but its wire protocol is never defined; its fragments disagree (lens CON). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:61-73; spec/13-encoding.md:117; spec/07-compliance.md:185-195; spec/10-relays.md:457. Fix: The reviewer overstates the gap. §5.2.1.1 (05:61-73) does define the behaviour: atomic consume on fetch, leaf-credential check, last-resort KeyPackage, rate limiting, and Welcome by POST. What is missing is the wire layer: the service `type` string, which differs between `KeyPackageEndpoint` and `AgoraKeyPackageEndpoint` (07:190); the path (`/v1/agora/kp/` vs `/v1/agora/keypackages`); and the publish method and its device-key authentication. Add these to §5.2.1.1 and align 07:190-191, 10:457 and 13:117. Full text: notes/review/CON-verified.md and notes/review/CON.md.
